arcane/arcane-beam.notes: buzzing hum wobbling 8x a loop, hiss at the hand, sizzle + spark crackle at the end swelling on the pushes (0.1, 0.7); start = gather + ignition zap; stop = hum sagging, end fizzing out

arcane/arcane-missiles.notes: gather (windup); 5 soft fwips at the launches, whirring hisses swelling and panning hand->target; pops on the hits 0.77/0.85/0.95/1.08, a full small energy hit at 1.2, its sparkle after the 0.07 hit-stop

arcane/arcane-orb.why: an orb floating in place, rings and motes turning round it: an idle glow, a silent thing stays silent (rule 2)

arcane/blink-in.notes: gather rushing in (0-0.26), zip as the line opens, bright noise widening (0.36-0.48); crack + energy + feet's knock on arrival (0.48), sparkling cool-out after the 0.03 hit-stop, stars winking out

arcane/blink-out.notes: outline crackling denser over a rising fizz (0-0.32), zap at the flash (0.32), zip up as it squeezes, sharp pop at 0.52, sparks winking out

arcane/magic-circle-cast.notes: pen scratch of light following the drawing (0.04-0.88), 8 rune crackles (0.9-1.3), charge to the flash, crack + energy + upward rush at 1.52, column hiss, glint burst at 2.42, runes popping out

arcane/mana-burst.notes: gather (0-0.22), energy nova with a rush out both ways at 0.22, sparkle fizz, 9 rune pops 0.64-1.2 where each rune stopped

arcane/portal.why: a rift standing open, swirling and pulling motes in, nothing changing: a steady thing with no noise of its own stays silent (rule 2); an opening/closing one-shot belongs to the game's own moment

arcane/rune-circle.why: a rune circle turning on the floor: a steady glow, silent (rule 2)

arcane/spell-charge.notes: fizzing hum pumped by the 4 ring landings; release when thrown; build = a one-shot charge

arcane/star-fall.notes: 11 falling hisses swelling and panning down their slant, each landing on its own time and place with a crack + small zap (big ones energy + a floor knock), sparks ticking

arcane/time-stop.notes: shwing as it opens, 8 dry ticks slowing over a hum/whirr sagging to nothing; cold glass crack at the freeze (1.75), silence, crackling 2.2-2.38, shatter at 2.42, shards tinkling down

critters/bat.why: a bat flying its figure-eight on 6 even wingbeats a loop: it never bursts or rests, so its flaps are a steady thing (rule 2) and a flap on each would tick like a clock (rule 1)

critters/bird.notes: burst of 4 wingbeats (0, 0.375, 0.75, 1.125), a soft rush of air on each downstroke; glide silent

critters/butterfly.why: a butterfly's wings make no noise you could hear: a steady thing (rule 2)

critters/eyeball.why: an eye floating and bobbing, its iris snapping round and its lids blinking: a hovering idle thing with no noise of its own (rule 2)

critters/fish-school.why: fish holding station under water, bubbles rising: a steady thing, nothing heard (rule 2)

critters/flying-skull.notes: jaw chatter: a bone clack each time the jaw shuts in the bursts 0.15-0.75 and 1.3-1.95; the gape snapping shut at 2.3; the crown fire silent

critters/frog.notes: push off (1.2), tongue whips out (1.34), smacks the fly (1.41), zips back; landing flesh smack + wet squash + dust + grit ticks (1.62), gulp (1.76); idle throat, blink and fly silent

critters/ghost.why: a sheet ghost bobbing over the floor: a hovering idle thing with no noise of its own (rule 2)

critters/jellyfish.why: a jellyfish pulsing under water: a steady thing, nothing heard (rule 2); its pulses are an even beat (rule 1)

critters/slime.notes: wet squeeze winding up (0.5-0.84), squelch springing up (0.84), goo string pops (0.965), drips pat down; splat (1.44) + 12 droplets patting down where they land

critters/snake.why: a snake slithering in place, humps rolling down its body, its tongue flicking: steady movement with no strong moment (rule 2); no hiss, it isn't threatening anyone

critters/wisp.why: a will-o'-the-wisp looping a figure-eight, its flame tail licking: a hovering flame, silent like a torch (rule 2)

explosions/barrel-explosion.notes: seam spitting faster + steel shudder + low groan rising (0-0.8), blast with the drum's steel bursting and tearing at 0.8, fuel roar, staves and the lid clanging down, fuel splashes, embers

explosions/big-explosion.notes: 3 detonations (0 deep on the ground, 0.13 and 0.25 shorter and higher in the air), 3 s rumble, rocks landing as stone knocks from ~0.6 s, brands as wood toks, embers

explosions/cartoon-pow.notes: rush in (0-0.05), fat crack + cartoon pop springing up and wobbling at 0.05, zip + star sparkles as it snaps away (0.66)

explosions/dirt-explosion.notes: muffled earth heave + ground knock and crunch + soil whoosh (0), short noise rumble, clods landing as earth knocks from ~0.35 s, grit

explosions/firework-burst.notes: shell fizz + whistle gliding up (0-0.42), sharp air bang + echo at 0.42, stars crackling out 1.42-2.5 (wide), glitter

explosions/firework-rocket.notes: ignition whoosh, climbing fizz fading up (0-1.05), air bang + echo at 1.05, frond sizzle, tip crackles 2.85-3.4

explosions/grenade.notes: clinks on the bounces (0.575, 0.867), roll, fuse fizz quickening, rattle; sharp small blast at 1.62 with shrapnel whizzing out and pinging, small fireball rumble, bits landing

explosions/implosion.notes: inward rush climbing rumble->hiss (0-0.8), cut with a dull noise thup, silence, pop at 1.02

explosions/nuke.notes: white crack (0) + deepest drop (0.05), base surge rushing out L/R, ~5 s rolling rumble, afterwinds, grit

explosions/plasma-explosion.notes: metallic crack + energy hit (downward zap, whoomp) at 0, electric buzz and arc snaps until 0.85, sparkles thinning

explosions/small-explosion.notes: crack + dropping thump at the flash (t 0), rumbling body, rocks landing as stone knocks, embers

explosions/smoke-bomb.notes: clinks on the bounces (0.454, 0.729), fuse sizzle quickening, soft pop + hiss at 0.95, smoke gushing out L/R, canister clink ~1.16, then silence while the cloud billows

fire/brazier.why: a brazier burning steadily: silent thing stays silent (a flare-up one-shot only when the game stokes it)

fire/campfire.why: a campfire burning steadily (licks, sparks, smoke): silent thing stays silent; it is ambient, not global environment

fire/candle.why: a calm candle flame: silent thing stays silent

fire/fire-breath.notes: roaring cone swelling with the roar curve, hiss at the lips, sparks crackling ahead; start/stop

fire/fire-ring.notes: charge (no notes) 0-0.32, crack + ground knock + fire whoosh at 0.32, ring rush splitting L/R with crackles on the lighting rings, target catching at 0.6 (right), rim burning down

fire/fire-tornado.notes: whirling roar + wind swaying with the spine (1 sway/loop, no beat), embers ticking; start/stop

fire/fireball.notes: fluttering roar + hiss of the flight, motes spitting; start = launch whoosh

fire/flame-pillar.notes: floor cracking denser + rumble swelling (0-0.55), crack + ground knock + fire whoosh at 0.55, roaring column to 1.95, collapse dying by 2.45, chunks landing as stone knocks, grit

fire/flamethrower.notes: nozzle hiss + stream roar on flow(); cough at 0.55 (pfft, spat sparks), re-light whump + surge 0.67-0.75

fire/meteor.notes: roar growing and panning in along the flight (0-0.62), impact at 0.62 (crack, ground knock + heave, fire whoosh), noise rumble, chunks (stone) and brands (wood) landing, embers

fire/spirit-flame.why: a ghost flame hovering in place, an idle glow: silent thing stays silent

fire/torch.why: a steady torch flame: silent thing stays silent (ignite one-shot only when the game lights it)

holy/blessing.why: a cone of light resting on the character, sparkles drifting through it: a status glow, silent (rule 2)

holy/divine-shield.why: a bubble of light held round the character, turning: a status glow with no noise of its own, silent (rule 2); a block on it is shield-block's hit

holy/feather-burst.notes: soft poof + light pop + ring of air out both ways at the pop (t 0), a flurry of feather swishes braking (0-0.3), then silence while they sink

holy/halo.why: a halo hovering over the head: an idle glow, silent (rule 2)

holy/heal.notes: petal sparkles + bright noise fading in (0-0.57), a glide + hiss climbing with the hoop (0.16-0.74), a bright pssh as it bursts over the head (0.74), motes winking out 0.95-1.5

holy/heal-aoe.notes: quiet gather (0-0.3), soft energy + glitter as the seed sinks (0.3), a rush rolling out both ways and slowing, 26 tiny pops where the plus signs sprout as the ring passes

holy/holy-pillar.notes: sun opening (glitter + glide up), shafts pouring down faster (0.3-0.66), crack + energy + sigil sizzle at 0.66, held shimmer with ember crackles, folding shut (2.05-2.45) with a puff, one glint at 2.75

holy/resurrection.notes: light pouring down (0-0.34) + soft landing, glide + hiss climbing the body (0.5-1.15), bright burst at 1.15, wings opening out L/R (1.1), halo glint 1.5, wingbeat whump + gust out both ways (2.34), sparkles as the wings come apart (2.95-3.2)

holy/smite.notes: quiet shimmer on the mark (0-0.42), rush + zap gliding down as the hammer drops (0.42-0.54), hammer of light at 0.54: crack + energy + stone/earth knock and crunch, dust out L/R, stone chips and grit knocking down

holy/sunburst.why: a sun turning slowly, rays breathing: a steady glow, silent (rule 2)

ice/blizzard-vortex.notes: whirling wind roar + whistle swelling with the swirl (2x) and sway (1x a loop), foot rush, ice crystals ticking as they pass; start = spinning up, stop = dying down

ice/freeze.notes: frost hissing in from both sides (0-0.16) and crackling up the body, denser (0.14-0.62); crisp crack at hit 0.62, 13 panes ticking into place after the hit-stop; silent hold; cracks at 2.2 and 2.34, the block shivering, cut at the white flash 2.46; shatter at 2.52, burst after the 0.05 hit-stop, panes and splinters knocking and tinkling down

ice/frost-breath.notes: icy hiss at the mouth flickering, gust rush down the cone, billows breathing out, crystals tinkling faintly; start = rush + frost crackle, stop = wind dying

ice/frost-nova.notes: icy gather (0-0.42); slam: ice crack + stone knock + ice burst at 0.42; after the 0.1 hit-stop the wave rushes out L/R and 18 crystals crunch up on their own sites/times, shards tinkling; target ices over (0.66); silent hold; soft melt slush (1.95-2.65); ice skin cracks off the target (2.9)

ice/ice-crystal.why: a crystal floating and turning in its own light, motes circling: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own stays silent (rule 2); collecting it is the game's own one-shot

ice/ice-lance.notes: loop: cold hiss of shearing air fluttering per frame + wake rush + shed crystals tinkling; launch: frost crackle + whoosh; hit: crack + ice burst + shatter, splinters

ice/ice-shatter.notes: crack + hard knock on the left face (0.26), chips tinkling, second crack (0.4), the block rattling (0.54) cut at the white flash (0.62); shatter at 0.68 flung right, chunks knocking/skidding and crumbling, splinters tinkling, ice dust rolling out

ice/ice-spikes.notes: cast puff (0.04), frost line crackling right with its head (0.04-0.48), 7 ice crunches as the clusters burst up (crest heaviest), shards tinkling; silent stand; shiver 1.2 cut at the white flash 1.36; shatter along the line at 1.42, pieces knocking down and crumbling

ice/icicle-fall.notes: a drip plips (~0.46), the icicle shivers with a faint creak (0.3-0.6), cracks off its root (0.6), chips tinkle, a rush as it drops; it stabs and shatters at 0.944, pieces knock/skid/crumble, splinters

ice/snowflake-burst.notes: short icy gather (0-0.16), cold pop at 0.16 (crisp crack, tinks, sparkling fizz, frost ring rushing out), faint glints on the flakes' own twinkles, silence as they settle and melt

impacts/blunt-hit.notes: dull crack + heavy flesh smack at the blob (t 0), soft dust puff in the body, 4 earth clods knock down 0.28-0.75 s

impacts/bullet-impact.notes: bright crack + stone tak on the wall (t 0, panned right), grit hiss, 8 chips knock where they land

impacts/crit-hit.notes: crack + steel ring + heavy flesh smack + tsing glide at the starburst (t 0), arcs rush out (0.03), short body, 10 shards tick down

impacts/ground-slam.notes: huge crack + heavy earth knock/crunch at the floor flash (t 0), two shock fronts rush out L/R (0.015-0.6), short ground body, 20 rocks land/bounce/settle as stone knocks

impacts/heavy-landing.notes: start = the fall (air rising); boots crack + earth knock at the hit (0.005); short body and second-ring whump after the 0.13 hit-stop; 12 pebbles hop away

impacts/hit-flash.notes: crack + flesh smack at the blow (t 0), short body after the 0.07 hit-stop

impacts/hit-spark.notes: bright crack + short steel ring at the flare (t 0), 6 hot chips tick down

impacts/impact-frame.notes: crack + heavy flesh smack on the white frames (t 0), short low push, an outward rush as the lines pull out (0.133)

impacts/parry.notes: steel clash: metallic crack + scrape at the X flash (t 0), the blades ring and shimmer ~1 s

impacts/ricochet.notes: faint incoming hiss, crack + stone tick at the glance (0.05), a whine gliding down as it skips off right, grit knocks and sparks skittering

impacts/shield-block.notes: start = thin glide up (brace); energy zap + crack + steel tick at the hit (0.005); fizzing ripple after the 0.09 hit-stop; dome blinks out at 0.5 with a glide down and thinning crackles

lightning/ball-lightning.notes: silent orb; once a loop (2.067) the zap to the floor: crack, energy, buzz, sparks

lightning/chain-lightning.notes: windup static -> charge at the hand (0-0.12), 3 leaps landing as cracks (0.17/0.245/0.32), each link's hum on its flicker after the freeze, pops as they give out (0.94-1.04)

lightning/charge-up.notes: charge 0-1.6 (noise + glide climbing, throb quickening, crackles denser), release crack + heavy energy (1.6), bolts buzz + ring whoosh + thunder after the 0.14 freeze, sparks

lightning/electrified.notes: crackling arc buzz re-struck every other frame + feet grounding out; jolts at 0.1/0.733/1.367 (crack, buzz flare, sparks)

lightning/lightning-strike.notes: sigil static + rising glide, leader stepping down (0.48-0.76), strike crack + energy + stone floor split (0.76), return strokes (1.04, 1.26) each after a dart, arcs racing out, thunder, grit

lightning/plasma-ball.why: a plasma lamp glowing on its stand, tendrils wandering: a steady prop with no strong moment; silent thing stays silent

lightning/spark-arc.notes: strike crack (t 0), climbing arc buzz rising + thinning to 1.42, snap pop, quiet gap, tiny gap sparks from 1.84 lead into the next strike

lightning/storm-cloud.notes: loop: rain hiss + low wind (no accents); strike one-shot at 1.73 (crack, re-strikes, thunder wrapping round); soft grumbles under the in-cloud flashes

lightning/tesla-coil.notes: steady discharge hiss; arc volleys buzz on their flicker (frames 2-66); floor zaps at frames 14 (right) and 47 (left) with sparks

lightning/thunderclap.notes: breath + sparks rushing in, the clap's crack + shock-ring blast (0.12), thunder + bolt buzzes + floor ring rushing out after the 0.13 freeze, the target zapped (0.42), crackles bleed off, grit

lightning/zap-hit.notes: zip in from the left (0-0.05), crack + energy at the snap (0.05), arc buzz strobing on its flicker + knot crackle to 0.45, jinking sparks tick

melee/claw-swipe.notes: 3 tearing rakes (0, 0.04, 0.08) with small flesh smacks on hits 0.04/0.08, full flesh smack at 0.12, body after the 0.08 hit-stop

melee/dagger-flurry.notes: 6 varied swish+ticks on the small hits (0.05-0.325), big swish 0.37, clank + flesh smack 0.42, glint burst after the 0.12 hit-stop

melee/double-slash.notes: down swish 0, light clank 0.06, up swish 0.14, full clank at the X 0.16, burst after the 0.14 hit-stop

melee/hammer-smash.notes: heavy air growing over the drop (0-0.15), crack + stone knock/crunch + dull clank at the slam (0.15), short ground body and dust after the 0.2 hit-stop, 15 rocks + 11 chips land and bounce

melee/heavy-cleave.notes: air accelerating over the arc (0.2-0.335), crack + stone knock/crunch + steel clank at the floor (0.335), short ground body, dust both ways and grit after the 0.2 hit-stop

melee/scythe-reap.notes: long low rush over the sweep (0.08-0.42, R to L) split by the dull cut at 0.14 and its 0.12 hit-stop, ragged cold hiss as it tears away (0.56)

melee/spear-sweep.notes: wide swish L->R front-loaded (0-0.16), wood tok + flesh smack at the shins (0.1), dust wake rolling right and grit after the 0.12 hit-stop

melee/spin-slash.notes: a full-turn swish panned with the edge, dipping behind the body (0-0.17), clank as the ring closes (0.17), fading rush after the 0.12 hit-stop

melee/sword-slash.notes: swish over the sweep (0-0.16), steel edge ring + flesh smack on the hit (0.06); start = the act's windup

melee/thrust.notes: short sharp rush hand->tip (0-0.07), pierce crack + flesh smack + tink (0.07), pull-back rush after the 0.12 hit-stop and the 0.06 hold

melee/uppercut.notes: quick rising rush (0.02-0.076), punch crack + heavy flesh smack at the top (0.076), short body after the 0.13 hit-stop

melee/whip-crack.notes: air rolling out faster and rising (0.02-0.21) hand->tip, a very sharp crack at the tip (0.21), hiss and recoil rush after the 0.1 hit-stop

moves/arrow-shot.notes: arrow loosed and flying across, hit spark at the target

moves/dash-strike.notes: the cut where the dash ends, a critical hit on the target

moves/earth-stomp.notes: the spike under the target as the boot lands

moves/fireball-throw.notes: charge (no notes) -> release -> panned flight roar -> small-explosion hit, body after the hit-stop

moves/ice-lance-throw.notes: charge, the lance across, a snowflake burst on the target

moves/meteor-call.notes: the circle under the caster, the meteor coming down on the target

moves/pistol-shots.notes: three shots: muzzle, tracer across, spark on the target

moves/rocket-launcher.notes: launch blast, the rocket speeding across, the explosion

moves/sword-combo.notes: a slash, a double slash a step on, a heavy cleave

nature/acid-splash.notes: wet splat + small wet whomp at 0.3, sizzle crackling hotter then out by 2.2 with bead pops at random, each landing drop hissing where it falls

nature/boulder.notes: heave + tumbling rumble and rush panned along the arc (0-0.48), stone crack + knock + thud at 0.479, rumble + dust rolling out, chunks thudding and grit ticking where they land

nature/earth-spike.notes: stone snaps quickening + groan (0-0.34), stone hit at 0.34 with smaller shards at 0.385/0.425, rumble, chunks knocking, rubble rain; strain from 1.18, cracks 1.40/1.50/1.58, crumble, stump grind

nature/healing-bloom.notes: soil knock + grit, rustle up (0-0.42), quiet gather of light (0.42-0.93) + petal rustle, bright pssh + sparkle at 0.93, silent motes/petals, 6 tiny winks as the petals twinkle out

nature/leaf-storm.notes: loop: wind whirling round (3 voices circling at their own rates) + leaf rustle + litter scuff, no accents; start: wind gathering; stop: dying away

nature/poison-cloud.why: a miasma creeping along the floor and curling up: gas makes no noise of its own, a steady thing (rule 2); a one-shot only if the game releases or ignites it

nature/quake.notes: 3 jolts (0.06/0.5/0.92: dull crack + stone knock + low noise + shudder, each smaller, own pitch; rift rip L/R on the first), ground rumble swelling, slabs thudding back, chunks and grit, rift grinding shut at 2.2

nature/root-snare.notes: 5 dirt bursts at the roots' own times (0.16-0.52) + creak tightening, snap at 0.62, squeeze creak after the 0.05 freeze, silent hold, splinter at 1.75, crumble + bark tocks after the 0.04 freeze

nature/spore-burst.notes: soil crack + rubbery swell (0-0.32), quivering rising tone + spore hiss (0.32-0.8), soft poof + soft smack + wobbling poof + sparkle at 0.8, cloud breath, silent drift, soil slide at 2.15

nature/thorns.notes: earth tearing L->R (0.04-0.54), 6 thorn punches 0.12-0.495 growing louder/lower and panned out, short rumble, chips/grit; silent hold; earth grind sliding L->R as they sink (1.45-2.1)

nature/tornado.notes: loop: deep roar + howling wind swaying with the spine + debris ticks (no accents); flash: distant crackle + grumble on the crown's lightning (1.24, 1.38); start/stop

nature/toxic-puddle.why: a tar puddle at rest, bubbles slowly doming and popping, vapour curling: a still puddle, a steady thing with no noise of its own (rule 2, like the campfire's sparks); its 8 pops a loop would recur every 4 s as a pattern (rule 1)

nature/vine-whip.notes: dirt burst + rustle up (0-0.14), creak coiling (0.1-0.36), lash air rising root->tip, whip crack + sap splat at 0.555, sap spatter, rustle back, earth grind sliding in (1.0-1.3)

pickups/chest-open.notes: wood toks + strap rattles + creaks at the 4 rattles (0.1-0.64), strain creak, iron lock clunk and lid kicked open at 0.8 (heavy wood tok, hinge creak, lighter tok), gold light burst; coins clink / gems tink where they land (own physics); collect from 2.55: one B5-E6 ding + a chirp per item; dust poof at 3.3

pickups/coin-spin.why: a coin turning and bobbing over its shadow: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/collect-burst.notes: collect (t 0): B5-E6 ding over a bright crack and the ring's quick wash; the twinkles' own wink-outs as tiny panned glints (0.5-1.15)

pickups/crystal-shard.why: a shard hovering and swaying, light pulsing through it, splinters orbiting: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/gem-spin.why: a gem turning on its axis, facets flashing: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/heart-pickup.why: a heart bobbing and beating its glow (a light pulse, not a heartbeat sound): an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/key-glint.why: a key hovering, a glint running down it: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/loot-beam.why: a dropped sword standing in its pillar of rarity light: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/potion.why: a flask rocking, its brew bubbling idly: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/power-star.why: a star rocking and swelling on its beat (a steady rhythm would be music, rule 1): an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

pickups/xp-orb.why: an orb racing its figure-eight with a comet tail: an idle pickup, a steady thing with no noise of its own, stays silent (rule 2); its sound is the moment it is collected (collect-burst, or the game's own one-shot)

projectiles/arrow.notes: loop: fletching flutter (a pose a frame) + thin air hiss; launch: string snap + thrum; hit: wood tok + knock, shaft quivers

projectiles/bullet-tracer.notes: loop: burning tracer hiss sputtering per frame, faint spark crackles; hit: crack + stone tak + grit

projectiles/cannonball.notes: cannon blast (t 0), the ball whooshes off right (0-0.49), smoke rumble, wadding ticks

projectiles/energy-disc.notes: loop: spinning saw whirr + metallic whine + filament crackle; launch: whoosh + spin-up; hit: bite + grind

projectiles/flare.notes: launch pop (t 0), rising hiss (0-0.85), burst crack (0.85), the star fizzes and drips sparks, guttering out by 3.95

projectiles/homing-missile.notes: ignition whoomp (t 0), roar + whine rising with speed panned along the arc (0-1.15), blast at the hit (1.15), rocks and grit land

projectiles/laser-bolt.notes: loop: thin buzz + fizz fluttering with the body's pulses; launch: glide-down shot; hit: zap

projectiles/magic-missile.notes: gather build (0-0.2), weaving hum panned along the path (0.2-0.82), burst on the target (0.82), stars twinkle out

projectiles/muzzle-pistol.notes: crack + thump at the flash (t 0), short gas boom, the casing clinks down and settles

projectiles/muzzle-shotgun.notes: big crack + deep thump + pellet hiss (t 0), rolling body; pump racks at 0.40/0.53, shell lands

projectiles/muzzle-smg.notes: 12 shots a loop (crack + thump + gas pop, each varied), brass casings clinking where they land

projectiles/plasma-shot.notes: loop: churning gurgle + corona sizzle + droplet pops; launch: thoom; hit: splat + sizzle

projectiles/rocket.notes: loop: motor roar following the jet's flicker + nozzle hiss + spark crackle; launch: ignition; hit: blast + rumble + 3 chunks

scifi/emp-blast.notes: charge climbing (noise + glide fluttering with the blink, arcs denser) 0-0.42; zap + crack + energy hit at the pop 0.42; star arcs, ring whoosh, bubble hum swelling and strobing off 1.25-1.58, skin arcs; short-out at 1.58 (zap, falling glide, dead pixels glittering), dead puck spitting

scifi/energy-core.why: a reactor core idling in its cage, beating and arcing to the bars on a fixed loop: a steady prop like the plasma lamp (rule 2); sounding its two beats a loop would only make a heartbeat rhythm (rule 1)

scifi/force-field.notes: silent dome; tracer zips in from the right (0.32, 1.40); heavy hit at 0.42 (zap, sizzle, energy whoomp; after the 0.07 hit-stop shell buzz, fractures crackling, sparks glancing); light hit at 1.5

scifi/glitch.notes: static bursts on frames 9-16, 33-37, 51-62 (level/mode/pan per frame from the JS's draws), a zap in, a click out, dead pixels ticking; silent calm between

scifi/hologram.why: an idle hologram turning over its projector, flickering and tearing as it always does: a steady display with no noise of its own (rule 2)

scifi/jetpack.notes: twin nozzle hiss + plume roar breathing with the flame length per frame, low rumble, random spits; start = ignition, stop = cut-out puff

scifi/laser-grid.why: a laser fence sliding and sweeping between its posts on a loop: a steady hazard, like a burning torch its scorching is part of the idle state (rule 2)

scifi/scanner.notes: brackets rise in, latch click at 0.3; scan buzz gliding down head to toe 0.42-1.6 with data-bit ticks; two same-pitch OK blips on the flashes 1.75/1.87 (UI confirmation); falling glide as they let go 2.5

scifi/teleporter-pad.why: a teleporter pad idling, rings rippling and light rising off it: a steady glow, silent (rule 2); a warp in or out is its strong moment (scifi/warp-in, warp-out)

scifi/tractor-beam.notes: faint beam hum; 7 rocks torn loose at the JS's times (crack, stone knock, dust, grit ticks), each spiralling up as a rush climbing to hiss panned round its spiral, a soft pop at the lens

scifi/warp-in.notes: gather + column dropping (0-0.34); slam crack + energy hit + vapour + sparks at 0.34; beam hum (overshoot, thinner from 0.52), scan glide falling head to toe 0.62-1.4 with spat motes, glint 1.82; beam pinching up 1.9-2.16, snap zip + crack + small energy hit at 2.16, sparks landing

scifi/warp-out.notes: windup breath; charge climbing, outline crackle denser (0-0.42); white flash zap at 0.42; body breaking into light 0.5-1.1 (fizz, rush, rising glide) over the beam's hum; foot lifts with a pop at 1.3, hum gliding up and cut at 1.62; sparks landing

shadow/black-hole.why: a disk turning round a black hole, debris spiralling in: a steady thing with no noise of its own stays silent (rule 2); its two gulps a loop would be a steady rhythm (rule 1)

shadow/curse.notes: dark gather over the head (0-0.55); bone stamp (crack, knock, bone tok) at 0.55; the curse flooding down after the 0.09 hit-stop; silent burn; bone crackling faster (1.72-1.98), snapping apart, chunks clacking down and grit

shadow/dark-explosion.notes: dark gather with two dull core beats, cut at 0.45; blast at 0.52 (crack, deep drop + sub, rings rushing out L/R); the sphere's flame roar over the rumble to 1.62; flame drawn back in, void energy pop at 1.84; void shards knocking/tinkling down, embers

shadow/eclipse.why: a black moon over a breathing corona: a steady glow in the sky, silent (rule 2)

shadow/grasping-hands.notes: pool opening (0-0.32); four arms splashing up (0.3-0.5) on their own times with drops patting, each hand snapping shut 0.36 s later; silent strain; each dragged under (1.45-1.8) with a sucking rush, a gulp and a small splash; the pool shuts with a low gulp (2.35)

shadow/hex-sigil.notes: burning pen scratching and spitting along its 5 strokes (0.12-1.57), panned with it; a dark charge swelling to the flare; 7 glyph pops (1.62-2.04); flare at 2.6 (crack, energy, ring out); crumble at 2.74, cinders pattering

shadow/life-steal.notes: crack + flesh smack on the target at 0.01, blood drops patting; after the 0.07 hit-stop 7 orbs whip home on their own times (~0.4-0.9) as whooshes panning target->caster, each a soft energy landing, a warm swell as the caster flushes

shadow/necro-skulls.why: skulls circling a cold flame on their orbit: an idle steady thing, silent (rule 2)

shadow/shadow-flames.why: inside-out flames burning steadily on the floor: a steady fire is silent like a torch (rule 2)

shadow/shadow-tendrils.notes: pool opening (0-0.34); 7 tentacles lashing up with splashes on their own times (0.3-0.6), drops patting; swishes where they whip; each sinking with a sucking rush, gulp and small splash (1.5-2.2); pool shuts with a low gulp (2.5)

shadow/soul-drain.notes: faint draw of air down the funnel; 4 souls at their own times: airy rip on the right, a whistling rush speeding down the funnel (panned right->left), a soft energy landing + crystal knock as each lands

shadow/void-orb.why: a black orb hanging in the air, a vortex winding into it: an idle orb, silent (rule 2); its two gulps a loop would be a steady rhythm (rule 1)

spawn/coin-drop.notes: poof pop + puff at 0; 7 coins clinking on their own bounces (JS Rng + physics, 0.4-1.6 s), each its own pitch; silent while they lie; tiny sparkles as they wink out 2.15-2.7

spawn/disintegrate.notes: windup breath, charge climbing + crackle denser (0-0.42); white flash zap at 0.42; pixels peeling 0.49-1.69 as a fizz on the front's speed over a gusting wind drifting right; wind drops, motes fade, ash ticks

spawn/dissolve-burn.notes: windup breath; feet catch at 0.15 (whoomp, low puff, sparks); fire roar + crackle swelling with the seam's climb 0.15-2.05; flames dying, ember spits, ash grit ticks

spawn/egg-hatch.notes: three rocks (knock + shell crack, louder each: 0.35/0.9/1.45) with chips ticking; shiver rattle to 1.98; burst crack + shell crack/pop + light pouring at 1.98; shell pieces knocking down; cup crumbling at 2.55

spawn/poof.notes: pop (crack + cartoon blip) and puff of air at 0, dust skids both ways; stars winking, 14 pips as the balls go (0.7-1.3 s, the JS's draws)

spawn/respawn-beam.notes: floor gather + pillar dropping (0-0.32); slam crack + zap + energy + floor knock + dust at 0.32; beam hum, scan glide rising feet to crown 0.4-1.35 with spark fizz, glint at 1.35; beam lifting away with a rising glide 1.47; sparks

spawn/shatter-death.notes: windup breath, frost crackling up the body (0-0.5); sealed: crisp crack at 0.5, glint glitter; crack + chips at 1.05, creaking denser; shatter at 1.4, body after the 0.09 hit-stop, facets knocking and shards tinkling down

spawn/soul-rise.notes: windup, outline shimmer rising (0-0.35); soft whoomp as the soul tears loose 0.35; body slumps with a soft thud at 1.05; faint rising whisper, motes glittering as it thins 1.8-2.55

spawn/spawn-portal.notes: rip tearing (0-0.21), open whoomp 0.21; quiet whirl with belches at 0.52/0.76; burst at 1.0 (crack, floor knock + energy, smoke, sparks, chunks knocking, wisp pops ~1.8-2.0); swirl whipping up 1.9-2.22, pop at 2.22, specks twinkling

spawn/summon-rise.notes: circle burning in from both fronts (0-0.5), catches 0.5, runes flare 0.78, ground rumbling; floor bursts at 1.05 (crack, earth knock + crunch, chunks + grit knocking); two heaves of sliding earth, second throws chunks 1.69; eyes flare sizzle 2.3; circle dying 3.4-4.2

status/bleeding.why: a lingering status: beads swelling and dripping into a pool, a spurt on each heartbeat (every 1.2 s): tiny drips on an even pulse would be a beat (rule 1), and the wound's sound is the hit that made it (rule 2)

status/burning.why: small flames licking off a character: a steady fire is silent like a torch (rule 2), and its flare every 0.6 s would be a beat (rule 1); catching fire is the one-shot (the fire hit that set it)

status/charmed.why: a heart beating over the head, little hearts floating up: a status glow (rule 2); its beat is a rhythm (rule 1)

status/confused.why: a spiral whirling over the head, question marks bobbing: a status glow (rule 2)

status/cursed.why: violet smoke rising, a stain creeping up, a skull glitching in: a lingering status glow (rule 2)

status/frozen.why: frost on the body, icicles dripping, a shiver every second: a lingering status (rule 2), its shiver an even beat (rule 1); freezing over and breaking free are the one-shots (ice/freeze)

status/haste.why: after-images and speed lines streaming behind: a status glow (rule 2); the steps are the character's own footsteps, not the status

status/petrified.notes: stone grinding up with the front + edge snaps + grit (0-0.95), a dull stone knock as it sets (0.95), a pebble or two; cracks running + chips + juddering rattle (1.75-2.2); burst at 2.2, rubble rumble and dust after the 0.08 hit-stop, chunks, flakes and grit knocking down

status/poisoned.why: green waves rolling up the body, veins creeping, sweat hissing, a wobble every 0.8 s: a lingering status (rule 2), its wobble and blister pops an even beat (rule 1)

status/rage.why: the body juddering on each heartbeat, steam jetting off the head, an anger mark throbbing: a status glow (rule 2) whose heartbeat is a rhythm (rule 1)

status/sleep.why: Zs floating up, a slow breathing glow: a status glow (rule 2); no snore, it would be a rhythm (rule 1)

status/slowed.why: a glassy clock ticking round in heavy steps: a status glow (rule 2), and ticks on its steps would be a metronome (rule 1)

status/stunned.why: stars and little birds circling the head: a status glow (rule 2); tweets would be a chirp melody (rule 1)

transitions/blinds.notes: slats swish shut with a wooden clack each running down the screen (0.24-0.66); a softer swish and faint ticks as they tilt open (1.02-1.75)

transitions/burn-away.notes: fire roar + crackles as much as the front burns in from the edges (0-1.18, L/R where it burns), closing whump at 1.18, dark, smoulder 1.5-1.8, ignition whoosh at 1.8, crackling front racing out (1.8-2.62)

transitions/crt-off.notes: tube off: glide falling with the squeeze (0.06-0.34) and the line (-0.56), static hissing out, pop at the dot (0.56), faint whine fading; on at 1.06: click + thunk, rising glide and static swell as the line and picture open (-1.42)

transitions/diamond-wipe.notes: glassy shimmer sweeping L->R with the swelling diamonds (0.04-0.9), glint tinks as they snap; silent while locked; lighter shimmer and winking glints as they shrink away (1.05-1.9)

transitions/glitch-wipe.notes: digital stutter: a burst per band jump on the original's 18 Hz ticks (dropouts on freezes, chirps on jerks back), panned at each edge, 0.03-0.78 in, 0.98-1.66 out; faint blips in the black

transitions/iris.notes: closing swoosh following the rim (0-0.62), faint rim glints, snap rush (0.9) and a glint click at 0.99; dark; flash pop at 1.2 with an opening whoosh (outQuart) and sparks

transitions/pixel-dissolve.notes: 8-bit crumble: a grain per block winking in on its own time (ticks for small, knocks for big, panned), 0.04-0.85; softer grains as they wink out, big first, small ones sparkling last, 1.12-1.9

transitions/shatter-wipe.notes: air rushing as the pane drops; glass slab lands at 0.55 (glass crack + tinks, knock, ring, chips) and bounces at 0.88/0.98; impact crack at 1.32 with cracks racing out; shatter at 1.62, cells breaking outward on the wave with splinters; falling shards glinting

transitions/slash-wipe.notes: blade sweep L->R (0.06-0.68): whoosh + steel ring + grinding sparks following its outCubic speed; second cut swish + shing at 0.84, tip sparks; low slip scrape 0.96; split whoosh + steel ring at 1.08

transitions/star-iris.notes: fluttering spin swoosh as the star closes (0-0.98, flutter gliding with the spin), faint tip glints, closing glint click at 0.98; dark; flash pop at 1.16 and the swoosh spinning open (-2.0) with a spray of stars

ui/achievement.notes: slide-in whoosh from the right (0-0.2) + settle knock; medal pops at 0.26: two-note confirm + metal clink + star sparkle; faint shine sweep L->R at 0.95; slide-off whoosh at 1.98

ui/coin-collect.notes: coin bursts at 0.3: collect ding + clink spray + sparks; each coin into the HUD on its own frame (0.87-1.57): a clink + counter tick, panned right; fold-away puff at 2.0

ui/combo-counter.notes: rising whoosh in from the left (0-0.1), slam at 0.1 (crack, UI pop, ring wash, sparks), one soft pulse pop at 0.5, whoosh out right at 1.1

ui/confetti.notes: cardboard popper bangs at 0.1 (left) and 0.26 (right) with a paper burst + smoke puff; paper rustle following how many bits flutter and where (own motion), fading as they settle; faint landing ticks

ui/countdown.notes: slams at 0, 0.62, 1.24 (crack + UI pop + spark ring) with a fuse hiss burning round between them (panned with the head); GO at 1.86: big pop + air rush + rising glide + sparks; pop away at 2.69

ui/crit-number.notes: slam at 0 (crack, big pop, short noise rumble, shard ticks) + tag stamp knock at 0.09; faint ember crackles and shine; fold suck at 0.8-0.92, tag pop at 0.98, number bursts at 1.11

ui/damage-number.notes: punch at 0 (crack + little pop + sparks); soft landing knock + tiny pop with a squash (~0.4) and a quieter hop landing (~0.53); silent fade

ui/exclamation.notes: spring-up at 0.04: quick thin glide up + surprise ticks, squash tick at the spring's turn; second tick flick at 0.48; small pop away at 1.15

ui/health-bar-hit.notes: open click; hit at 0.2 (crack + pop + chips); drain 0.62-1.05: sparking fizz + thin falling glide panned with the edge; fold puff at 1.62

ui/heart-lost.notes: hit at 0.14 (crack + pop + sparks); crack racing down with a trembling rattle 0.24-0.5; split at 0.5 like glass (crisp crack, tinks, chips, dust); the halves puff out L and R at 0.95

ui/level-up.notes: gold gather 0-0.28; bright crack at the hit (0.28), after the freeze the pillar bursts up: rising glide + whoosh + dying glitter; lift-off whoosh 1.02-1.34; letters land (0.61-0.97) as small knocks; two-note confirm at 1.06; letters pop away from 2.36

ui/quest-complete.notes: ribbon unroll rustle out to both sides (0-0.32) + faint typing ticks; seal drops and toks (wood) at 0.95 (right), check scratch + two-note confirm at 1.03 (inside the at-most-two-notes rule); seal pop at 2.05, ribbon rolls away at 2.08

water/bubbles.notes: loop: the vent's 46 bubbles blub as they break the surface (each its own pitch and time, from the original's cycle), soft burble at the vent; no accents

water/drip.notes: silent swell; plink into the puddle at 1.184 and a smaller one from the rebound at 1.444 (new pitch each take)

water/fountain.notes: loop: soft splashing wash + jet hiss + the basin's patter of small plinks at random; no accents

water/geyser.notes: heave rumble + blubs quickening + 4 spurt sploshes (0-1.15), water burst (whomp + spray) at 1.15, column roar surging, slumping 2.6-3.3, drops pattering back, collapse splatter ~3.2, sputters 3.45/3.85, steam

water/rain-splash.notes: loop: rain hiss + dense random fine-drop ticks + the 8 big drops as soft splats inside the patter; no accents

water/ripples.why: still dark water with rings spreading: a steady thing with no noise of its own (rule 2); its drop falls on a strict 0.5 s clock, so a plink on each would be a metronome (rule 1)

water/splash.notes: wet crack + water plunk (whomp, bloop) + spray whoosh at 0.16, crown churn, rising bloop of the jet (0.46), drops plinking where they land, bead plink, 3 glugs (1.31/1.56/1.86), foam fizz

water/water-jet.notes: loop: nozzle hiss (left) + stream rush + spray spitting off its end (right), steady, no pump; start: valve 'pshh' + gush; stop: pressure falling, a sputter

water/water-orb.why: an idle orb of water floating and wobbling, its drips small: a steady thing with no noise of its own (rule 2); a one-shot only if the game bursts or summons it

water/waterfall.notes: loop: deep roar of the falling sheet + foam churn + spray hiss; no accents

water/wave-crash.notes: swell rushing in L->centre + crest spray hiss + lip curl rising (0-1.2), crash at 1.2 (slap, big water whomp into a wash, white-water burst), foam surging right and calming, drops splattering, lace fizz

water/whirlpool.notes: loop: swirling wash circling once a loop + low gurgle at the eye; no accents

weather/aurora.why: curtains of light rippling over the stars: light makes no noise, a steady thing stays silent (rule 2)

weather/blizzard.notes: loop: low wind roar, a gust body swelling twice a loop and panning left to right with the JS's gust crest, snow hiss brightening in the gust; no accents

weather/cherry-blossoms.why: petals drifting down on a light breeze: a steady thing with no noise of its own (rule 2); the breeze is no gale, so it is not a global wind loop

weather/clouds.why: clouds drifting past the moon: a steady thing with no noise of its own (rule 2)

weather/falling-leaves.why: leaves swinging down and settling in the litter: a steady thing with no noise of its own (rule 2); its gusts are a breeze, not a gale

weather/fireflies.why: fireflies glowing up and fading over the grass: light, a steady thing with no noise (rule 2)

weather/fog.why: banks of fog drifting: a steady thing with no noise of its own (rule 2)

weather/god-rays.why: shafts of light swaying, dust motes drifting through them: light, a steady thing with no noise (rule 2)

weather/rain.notes: loop: rain hiss (a take per ear) drifting with the gust sheets, dense splash patter, low wash; no accents

weather/shooting-stars.why: meteors burning across a far night sky: too far to be heard, light only, a steady sky (rule 2); a whoosh would be magic, not material (rule 5)

weather/snow.why: snow drifting down in a gentle breeze and settling: falling snow makes no noise (rule 2); a gale is the blizzard's loop

weather/storm.notes: loop: driving rain hiss + patter + low wind (no accents); strike one-shot from 2.62: leader stepping down, crack + energy whoomp at 3.0, restrike 3.3, buzz on the flicker, floor arcs, sparks, steam, thunder; sheet lightning 6.4 as a far grumble; fainter grumbles under the far flickers (8.6, 0.9)
